overview: This file traces Japanese industrial conditions from 1930 to 1938 through reports, consular despatches, research circulars, pamphlets, and file notes. It covers industrial rationalization, export competitiveness, labor in Nagoya and Aichi, nationalist obstacles to Ford’s expansion, and the effects of the China Incident on Osaka’s smaller industries and consumer exports.
interest: It combines industry statistics, local labor accounts, Ford’s expansion difficulties, and manufacturers’ reports of wartime shortages.
